Pick your TV or projector in the cast menu, then come back. If it isn\'t listed, connect by HDMI or turn on the TV\'s screen mirroring.

1. Aim the projector at the floor and press Cast to projector / TV (or plug in HDMI).
2. Edit keystone: drag the 4 corners until the grid fits the floor.
3. Point the phone camera (or a network camera) at the floor and press Calibrate camera to floor.
4. Pick a scene. Tap the projection any time to open or hide these controls.

No camera? Turn on Touch acts as a person and walk with your finger.
Games start when someone stands on the glowing START circle.
Source code and releases on GitHub

Camera and microphone frames are processed on this phone and never leave it. Nothing is recorded or uploaded. A network camera streams only over your own Wi-Fi, and the only internet request is a check on GitHub for a newer version.

Made by PixelCrunch. Every visual and sound is generated live on your phone, with no video or audio files.\n\nBuilt with Google ML Kit (pose and object detection), AndroidX CameraX and Media3, Material Components, and Kotlin coroutines, used under the Apache License 2.0.
PhantomFloor is free. If it made your party, a small donation keeps new scenes and games coming.
